card.name: Separators inside combination drug names
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', or the end of a drug name that sits between ingredients in a multi-drug product name, such as 'sodium sulfate, potassium sulfate' or 'dextroamphetamine saccharate, amphetamine'.

modes.label: Comma between ingredients
modes.description: A comma after one ingredient in a list of active ingredients that forms a product name.
modes.example: Concurrent use of stimulant laxatives and sodium sulfate<<,>> potassium sulfate and magnesium sulfate oral solution may

modes.label: Inside an ingredient name
modes.description: The last piece of a drug name or the word 'and' just before the next ingredient is named.

card.writes: It seems to help predict the next ingredient name that repeats in a combination product title.
card.plain: It marks the spot between ingredients in a combination drug name, where the next ingredient is expected.
